recipe.visualDefinition: A centered monochrome male portrait set against a high-contrast, ethereal cloudscape. The composition features a distinct 1970s aesthetic with a combination of black-and-white photography for the subject and a stylized, multi-layered typographic header at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a desaturated, textured cloud background
Top-aligned horizontal title bar providing a color accent to a neutral palette
Bottom-left justified tracklist providing balance to the central figure
Soft, diffused lighting creating a halo effect around the subject's head
coreInvariants: Ethereal cloud texture across the entire background
Monochrome treatment of the central human figure
Linear, horizontal placement of the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, waist-up portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark mass of the jacket create a central anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colorful top title, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the jacket line to the bottom-left text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of cloud-filled negative space in the upper quadrants to create an airy, celestial mood.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grey and off-white for the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the subject's clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, orange, and blue used exclusively in the thin outlines of the top typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark jacket and bright clouds.
paletteRestrictions: Primary-adjacent triadic accents for text outlines

letterConstructionRules: Multiple concentric outlines in varying colors
Tight letter spacing with no overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are elongated vertically to create a 'tall' display effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative display header paired with functional, minimalist metadata text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines above and below the title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Bauhaus or Avant Garde Gothic

candidateDirections.reason: Good base for the tall, tight display text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome portrait of a man with 70s hair and attire (dark jacket, open collar shirt) centered against a bright, high-contrast, grainy cloudscape. Ensure the top 20% of the image is relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered uppercase title at the top using a geometric sans-serif. Apply three thin concentric outlines in yellow, orange, and blue. Add a list of text in the bottom-left corner in a small, clean sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait monochrome while the title text has color accents?
Are the clouds textured and high-contrast?
Is the title text outlined with multiple colors?
Is the composition centered and balanced?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and tracklist wording
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text outlines are distinct and not blurred.
Verify the monochrome subject doesn't bleed into the background colors.
Check that the bottom-left text is legible against the cloud texture.
Confirm the overall 'dreamy' 70s mood is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome portrait + Ethereal cloudscape + Multi-outline geometric header = 70s Celestial Pop Aesthetic
